groups.defect: ClientPermissionsV2.setPermissionsEnabled throws UnsupportedOperationException, and the ClientRemovedEvent listener in AdminPermissions calls it, so deleting a client fails when V2 is enabled.
groups.rationale: All three describe the same listener-to-throwing-method interaction, some from the listener side and some from the method side. One fix resolves it.

groups.defect: ClientPermissionsV2.canExchangeTo throws UnsupportedOperationException, so token-exchange requests fail with HTTP 500 under V2.
groups.rationale: Both point at lines 147-150 and describe the token-exchange flow breaking because canExchangeTo throws.

groups.defect: The management-permission methods in ClientPermissionsV2 (isPermissionsEnabled, getPermissions, resource, and the *Permission accessors) throw UnsupportedOperationException, so the client management/permissions admin REST endpoints return 500 under V2.
groups.rationale: Both report the same set of throwing overrides breaking the admin management-permissions REST endpoints.

groups.defect: The Javadoc on the void methods requireView() and requireViewClientScopes() wrongly says they return true, instead of saying they throw ForbiddenException.
groups.rationale: The same copy-paste Javadoc mistake appears on two require* methods. Each needs its own edit, but one approach fixes both.
